name: zamana-ai
description: Zamana AI - Intelligent business intelligence platform

scripts.build:tests: npx tsc --ignoreConfig --outDir dist --declaration false --module node20 --target ES2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution node16 --lib ES2022 --types node tests/auth.test.ts tests/health.test.ts tests/security.test.ts tests/error-handler.test.ts tests/integration/auth-api.test.ts src/index.ts src/config/database.ts src/config/jwt.ts src/config/security.ts src/config/server.ts src/controllers/auth.controller.ts src/middleware/auth.middleware.ts src/middleware/error-handler.middleware.ts src/routes/auth.routes.ts src/routes/health.routes.ts src/types/api.types.ts src/types/auth.types.ts src/types/error.types.ts src/utils/logger.ts src/utils/validators.ts
scripts.db:test:setup: node -e "const { config } = require('dotenv'); config({ path: '.env.test' }); require('./src/config/database');"
scripts.db:test:reset: node -e "const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client'); const { PrismaPg } = require('@prisma/adapter-pg'); const { config } = require('dotenv'); config({ path: '.env.test' }); const adapter = new PrismaPg({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL }); const prisma = new PrismaClient({ adapter }); prisma.$connect().then(async () => { await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "User" CASCADE'); await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "Organization" CASCADE'); await prisma.$disconnect(); })"
